housing.summary: Numbeo reported an average monthly rent of SEK 16,933.33 for a one-bedroom apartment in Stockholm city centre on 2 September 2026; Bostadsförmedlingen is the Stockholm Rental Agency and lists vacant rentals. No reliable deposit-month norm was found.

banking.summary: Swedbank says newcomers without Mobile BankID apply at a physical drop-in office, complete its customer-due-diligence and tax-residency forms, prove identity and, depending on status, provide a Swedish Tax Agency register extract and documents explaining account use and finances.
required_docs: completed Swedbank customer-due-diligence and tax-residency forms
approved passport, or an EU/Schengen national identity document for an EU/EEA citizen
Swedish Tax Agency register extract showing a coordination number, if available
supporting documentation explaining account use and finances, such as an employment contract, salary proof or current-bank statements

schools.summary: The City of Stockholm directory lists international schools at compulsory-school level, and Stockholm International School confirms that it offers the International Baccalaureate continuum through the Diploma Programme.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer who moves to Sweden and plans to live there for at least one year should notify the Swedish Tax Agency to be listed in the Population Register, then book and attend an in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the Moving to Sweden notification to the Swedish Tax Agency and attend the booked in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre.

tax_finance.summary: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is first listed in the Swedish Population Register; a person planning to stay less than one year may need a coordination number instead.

transport.summary: SL provides public-transport information for Stockholm, and its temporary adult price for a 30-day ticket is SEK 530 for tickets bought no later than 1 December 2026. Driving-licence exchange is governed by the Swedish Transport Agency, while healthcare eligibility for a newcomer follows population registration.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EEA licence may be exchanged by a permanent resident. Among non-EEA licences, only licences from the United Kingdom, the Faroe Islands, Switzerland or Japan may be exchanged under the stated conditions. Source: https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/
transport.healthcare_registration: If staying at least one year, register in the Swedish Population Register through the Swedish Tax Agency; once registered, the newcomer is entitled to public medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents. Source: https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden
